prompt: Implement a modular Real-Time Chat Server in C# with three isolated components: (1) TCP Connection Manager handling client handshakes and keep-alive heartbeats, (2) Room Management Subsystem supporting channel creation, broadcasting, and user permission roles, and (3) Message Persistence Engine asynchronously buffering chat history to a relational store.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Connection Score: 0-5 (Evaluates async TCP socket management and heartbeat monitoring)
Module 2 Room Score: 0-5 (Evaluates broadcast efficiency and thread-safe room collections)
Module 3 Persistence Score: 0-5 (Evaluates background batch persistence and queue safety)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates full duplex communication flow and decoupling)
